evidence.title: KellyBoost: Growth-Optimal Portfolio Construction with Gradient-Boosted Trees

summary: Researchers introduce KellyBoost, a novel method for growth-optimal portfolio construction leveraging gradient-boosted decision trees. The approach aims to enhance investment strategies by combining machine learning with the Kelly criterion for optimal capital allocation.
title: KellyBoost: AI-Powered Portfolio Optimization Using Gradient-Boosted Trees
